question: What specific outcomes are assigned to the fourfold nakshatra groups combined with weekdays?
premises: The preceding verses group nakshatras in sets of four beginning with Viśākhā in combination with weekdays beginning with Sunday.
This verse enumerates distinct outcomes corresponding to those grouped divisions.
The listed outcomes include thief, enjoyment-power, wealthy, king, and eunuch.
inference: Each of the fourfold nakshatra-weekday groupings is associated with one of these named outcomes.
uncertainties: The exact one-to-one mapping between each group and each listed outcome is not explicit within this verse alone.
The precise sense of bhuktiśakti in this ritual context may be enjoyment-power or capacity for enjoyment.
plain_english: They are: a thief, one with power of enjoyment, a wealthy person, a king, and a eunuch.
